profile_text.body:
Deere & Co's website presents the company under the John Deere name as a provider of agricultural, construction, and forestry machinery, along with technology and services. The site directs visitors to find a John Deere dealer in their area or purchase online.

No AI products or MCP servers are listed for the company.

The company is a for-profit public company headquartered in Moline, Illinois, trading under the ticker DE with CIK 0000315189. It is associated with 375 law exposure entries in Illinois, and no specific cases are listed.
